quests.tfg_tips.first_sacks.desc:
The &6Leather Sack&r and &3Burlap Sack&r are two options for portable storage with their own pros and cons. It is a good idea to view the container info for each one to know how many &ditem slots&r, the &dstack size&r, and the max &ditem size&r for each sack.

&l&3Tip:&r The &4&oField Guide&r has more specific info on some of the special features of the sacks.
quests.tfg_tips.vessels.desc:
&dSmall Vessels&r have 4 inventory slots while &6Large Vessels&r have 9! The &dSmall Vessel&r is not just for item storage, but is also necessary for smelting and alloying basic metals.
The &6Large Vessel&r is heavier to carry, but is great for preserving food.

&l&3Tip:&r&o Large Vessels double as early backpacks!
quests.tfg_tips.backpack_materials.desc:
There are two options for backpacks: the &5Frame Pack&r or the &3Sophisticated Backpack&r

A &5Frame Pack&r is a dense backpack allowing you to store up to &c64&r items in each slot no &omatter their standard stack size&r.

A &3Sophisticated Backpack&r is the primary way to expand your portable inventory size going forward. The first tier will more than double your normal inventory, and further tiers increase it even more! It also comes with a wide variety of &afunctional upgrades&r, and different parts of it can be dyed different colors!
quests.tfg_tips.first_backpack.desc: This is your first &3Sophisticated Backpack.&r It has a total of &c36&r inventory slots and can hold &aone upgrade.&r Check the two branches after this to learn about inventory and backpack upgrades.
quests.tfg_tips.hazard_materials.title: Matières Dangereuses
quests.tfg_tips.glassblowing_tools.desc:
To work &dGlass&r you'll need a variety of tools.

&3Paddle&r: Performs flatten, mainly used for creating &dGlass Panes&r and &dLamp Glass.&r
&3Gem Saw&r: Besides being mandatory for making glass products, it can be used to pick up &dGlass&r and &cGem Buds&r in-world as well, like a &bSilk Touch&r effect!
&3Jacks&r: Used to pinch glass, mostly used for containers such as &dGlass Bottles.&r
&3Wool Cloth&r: Used for rolling glass, needed for &dLenses&r and &dJars.&r
quests.tfg_tips.burlap_cloth.subtitle: Made out of Jute!
quests.tfg_tips.burlap_cloth.desc:
By soaking some &aJute&r in a barrel, and working the resulting &aJute Fibers&r in the &3Loom&r, you can create &dBurlap Cloth.&r

Burlap Cloth has a number of uses, such as creating &bBurlap Clothes&r that protect against &chot environments&r, &eBeekeeper Armor&r that protects from angry bees, and a number of other utility items.
quests.tfg_tips.silk_cloth.subtitle: Very, Very Smooth.
quests.tfg_tips.phantom_silk.desc: &dPhantom Silk&r is weaved from Phantom Thread, which itself is crafted from Phantom Membrane. You can find &aPhantoms&r in the &4Beneath&r.
quests.tfg_tips.digger_helmet.desc.1: The &dDigger Helmet&r is a helmet you can wear that will automatically light up your surroundings, hands-free! Useful if your main hand is occupied and your off-hand is equipped with a shield. It will require a bit of &6Glowstone&r to craft. Maybe you can reach to &4The Beneath&r for some early game access...
quests.tfg_tips.dye_discs.desc: By dipping a &bBlank Disc&r in a &aBarrel&r filled with dye, you can create the vanilla in-game discs. Enjoy classics such as &dWait, 13&r and &dBlocks!&r
quests.tfg_tips.special_discs.subtitle: These are unique... Or they where, at least
quests.tfg_tips.camera_attachments.task: A Toggleable Light Source or a Spyglass
quests.tfg_tips.create_rubber_ingot.desc: Utilizing the &bVacuum Chamber&r and some additional heating, you can process &aLatex&r from various trees into &dRaw Rubber Pulp&r through a specific process. You can then smelt together 3 &dRaw Rubber Pulp&r with a bit of &eSulfur Dust&r in an &bAlloy Smelter&r to create &dRubber Ingots&r, perfect for insulating cables and very much necessary to advance in the &2Voltaic Age&r and beyond...
quests.tfg_tips.reinforced_glider.desc: If you combine an &aElytra&r, made in &6HV&r, with a &aHang Glider&r, you'll obtain a &dReinforced Glider.&r It has greater durability and a higher velocity ceiling.
quests.tfg_tips.warfare.desc:
You can outfit your &bSloop&r with firepower via the &dCannon&r and cannon balls, in case you want to blow something to smithereens.
To fire a cannon, you'll need to load it with some &aGunpowder, Unrefined Paper&r and your &aCannon Ball&r. Then light the wick with &cFlint and Steel.&r
quests.tfg_tips.kayak_materials.desc: The &dKayak&r is the second most simple boat you can craft, requiring &bWaxes&r for the &aWaterproof Hides&r. It is also the &conly&r boat that can be picked up as an item. Despite having a &dsingle passenger&r slot, it is the fastest boat in the game until the steel age &dSloop!&r
quests.tfg_tips.create_canoe.title: Complete the Canoe
quests.tfg_tips.create_rowboat.title: Complete the Rowboat
quests.tfg_tips.sloop_under_construction:
The &dSloop&r is the most advanced seaworthy vessel, requiring &aSteel.&r It has ample space for storage, anvils and workbenches! It is incredibly expensive and requires practice to sail. The &2Field Guide&r has all the details for construction and on how to sail.

Again, do not attempt to mix up different kinds of hardwoods in the same vessel.
quests.tfg_tips.tools_tips.title: Tips - Tools
quests.tfg_tips.tools_tips.tools.desc: The only thing seperating man from animal is our use of &l&bTools&r&r. &7&oExcept for apes, monkeys, dolphins, crows, otters, octo.......&r&r Use your skills and tools to make the most of this world, and &5save yourself&r some effort.
